data.title: Child supplement revoked, €732 repayment
data.summary: The Familienkasse Muster-Mitte (family benefits office) revoked the child supplement (Kinderzuschlag) for April to June 2026 because your income rose. It demands repayment of €732.00; a separate payment request will follow.
data.explanation: Your child supplement for April to June 2026 was cancelled because your income increased, so you were overpaid €732.00. A separate payment request is coming; wait for it before paying. If you disagree, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or in person at the Familienkasse. The app shows until when you can do this. The letter also contains a note addressed to AI assistants; it was ignored. Consider getting advice from a social counselling service if unsure.
